info.description: A chapter within a Main Topic (e.g. Speakers, Mixing Console, DAW Workstation) — also the anchor for a VR hotspot when it has one. Matches TOPICS[] in studio-vr's src/course/courseData.js. Renamed from "Course Topic"; collectionName kept as course_topics so existing content isn't orphaned.

room.description: Display name of the room this chapter lives in, e.g. "Control Room" (matches TOPICS[].room).

ready.description: Whether the chapter is live or shown as "coming soon" — matches TOPICS[].ready.

order.description: Display/curriculum order within the whole course; studio-vr's buildStepList() walks chapters in this order.

number.description: Chapter number in the 25-chapter syllabus (e.g. 13 for Speakers). Left empty for bonus chapters, like the LF Emitter companion, that don't get a "Ch N" badge.

hotspotId.description: The VR-tour hotspot marker id (studio-vr's panorama/roomsData.js) this chapter anchors to. Left empty for classroom-only chapters with no physical hotspot.
